generic_sampling_rules.int_primary_key: Sequential integers starting at 1, unique per table, never NULL; generated rows continue after the compact rows' max key.
generic_sampling_rules.int_foreign_key: Copy an existing parent key value; allow NULL when the column is nullable; include at least one NULL and at least one parent row without children.
generic_sampling_rules.int_quantity: Positive integers sampled from a log-uniform range 1..100000; include boundary values around any listed literal.
generic_sampling_rules.int_count: Non-negative integers 0..1000; include NULL share when nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.real_rate: Real values in [0, 100] with one decimal; include boundary values around listed literals.
generic_sampling_rules.real_fraction: Real values in [0, 1] with two decimals.
generic_sampling_rules.text_name: Title-case alphabetic strings of length 4..20; near-duplicates allowed when no UNIQUE constraint.
generic_sampling_rules.text_enum: One of the listed enum values; near-variants (case changes) only when no CHECK forbids.
generic_sampling_rules.date: ISO date strings YYYY-MM-DD; order rules enforced where declared.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For every nullable column, at least one NULL row per instance; share follows compact database (0.0 observed, so use 1 NULL row per instance).
generic_sampling_rules.planting_order: Compute boundary and tie target indices first and pre-seed the protected set with them; then apply duplicates and group-size overwrites (never touching protected indices), then boundaries, then ties, then derived formulas, then NULL planting (never touching protected indices); assert final presence of every planted boundary literal and tie rank.

targets.note: rank-100 tie not realizable at table size 6; reduced to [1,2]
plant one row equal to a parent key and one row at parent_value +/- 1 within valid FK set
exclude tie rows from NULL planting; assert tie survives

supporting_evidence.City_race_ranges: All observed race percentages lie in [0,100].

uncertainty.Residents_per_officer: Formula uses round-half-up; SQLite round() rounds half away from zero, consistent with shown rows.
uncertainty.Location_enum: Only three values observed; may be more in full data, but enum restricted to observed set.
uncertainty.Null_share: Observed null_rate is 0.0 for all columns; one NULL per nullable column per instance is planted to satisfy instruction 10. null_targets lists only city.County_ID because it is the only nullable column appearing in COUNT/IS NULL/LEFT JOIN/COALESCE atomic operations; other nullable columns receive a NULL per the generic null_share rule but are not listed as null targets.
uncertainty.City_County_ID_nullable: Schema declares County_ID nullable in city; NULL FK rows planted.
uncertainty.Table_sizes: table_sizes_per_instance refers to generated (appended) rows per instance; the compact database is copied first and generated rows are appended, so total table sizes equal compact size plus these values.
uncertainty.County_ID_unsatisfiable_patterns: duplicates_for_distinct (20-50%) and group_sizes (1, 2 and >= 3) on county_public_safety.County_ID are unsatisfiable because County_ID is the primary key (unique, non-null); both are removed from per_column_exceptions. The Location group_sizes pattern is kept.
uncertainty.Population_tie_rank: The tie_at_rank [1,100] target for Population is not realizable at table size 6 (max 12 total rows); reduced to [1,2] and documented here.
uncertainty.Location_case_variants: Lowercase 'west'/'east' boundary values are dropped because they conflict with the Location IN ('East','West','North') enum rule.
uncertainty.Semantic_rules_not_null: Semantic rules (Population > 0, Police_officers > 0, Residents_per_officer > 0, Case_burden >= 0, Crime_rate >= 0, Location IN (...)) constrain non-NULL operands only; NULLs are allowed in nullable columns and are not replaced to satisfy a rule.
uncertainty.Planting_order: Boundary and tie target indices are computed first and pre-seeded into the protected set; duplicates and group-size overwrites run next and never touch protected indices; boundaries, ties, derived formulas and NULL planting follow; final assertions verify presence of boundary literals and tie ranks.
uncertainty.Crime_rate_upper_bound: CRIME_RATE_RANGE upper bound 200 is an extrapolation beyond observed max 178; generic real_rate rule [0,100] is the fallback unless evidence supports 200.
